fluff.overview: Lyran infantry draw confidence from knowing their equipment is first-rate, even when assigned to garrison duty on worlds far from the front lines. Foot infantry platoons form the backbone of the LCAF's garrison forces, deploying on foot to hold positions, patrol perimeters, and secure urban areas where vehicles cannot easily operate. Armed with assault rifles and infantry-portable long-range missile launchers, these platoons can engage armored targets at distances well beyond normal infantry weapon range, providing indirect fire support to the formation.
